open_points.subject: correct_expense
open_points.text: - correct_expense: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction by beginning it with begin of the store, which returns a PortalTransaction, read the aggregate only through get_expense_aggregate of the expenses repository of that transaction with expense_id, resolve every target that is the section member of = models.AllocationTargetKind inside that same transaction only through get_project_section of the project_sections repository of that transaction with the project_id of the context and section_id, write only through update_expense_aggregate of the expenses repository of that transaction, append the audit only through the audit repository of that transaction, and commit exactly once; it MUST NOT call validate_project_section, open a nested transaction while this one is active, or use a legacy PortalTransaction expense or project-section method.
open_points.question: The note must name the SECTION member, or the enum surface must define a member named section.

open_points.subject: correct_expense
open_points.text: - correct_expense: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise ExpenseValidationError when an instruction whose target is the section member of = models.AllocationTargetKind carries no section_id or when the project_sections repository of that transaction returns no section for the project_id of the context and that section_id, so a cross-project or unknown section can never be allocated and no partial correction commits.
open_points.question: The note must name the SECTION member, or the enum surface must define a member named section.

open_points.subject: correct_expense
open_points.text: - correct_expense: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST build exactly one audit intent with the imported build_project_audit_intent from the context, the expense.correct member of = models.AuditAction as action, the expense member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind and the corrected expense_id as entity_id, and append it via the audit repository of that transaction.

open_points.text: - replace_expense_allocations: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise ExpenseValidationError when an instruction whose target is the section member of = models.AllocationTargetKind carries no section_id or when the project_sections repository of that transaction returns no section for the project_id of the context and that section_id, and MUST validate the instruction sum against the unchanged persisted total_amount before constructing any replacement allocation.
open_points.question: The note must name the SECTION member, or the enum surface must define a member named section.

open_points.subject: replace_expense_allocations
open_points.text: - replace_expense_allocations: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST build exactly one audit intent with the imported build_project_audit_intent from the context, the expense.allocate member of = models.AuditAction as action, the expense member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind and the expense_id whose allocations were replaced as entity_id, and append it via the audit repository of that transaction.
